The score is assigned by Buró de Crédito, a company that collects the history of people who have had loans and credit cards.
Its scale ranges from {rMinimum} to {rMaximum} points. The lower the score, the more likely a person is to miss a payment.
There are 4 levels: low, fair, good, and excellent. Starting at 668 points is considered positive.
How is it interpreted?
Payment punctuality: the score is affected if there are delays in the payment.
Moderate use of credit lines: the score may decrease if you use a large portion of revolving credit lines (such as credit cards) without maintaining timely payments.

carbon-footprint-overview-evolution-moda:
The carbon footprint is the name given to the impact our actions have on the planet. This footprint is measured in CO2 (carbon dioxide) emissions, weighed in kilograms or tons.

The accumulation of CO2 and other gases, known as greenhouse gases, is behind climate change. The Paris Agreement, signed in 2016 by United Nations countries, is a global commitment to slow global warming and prevent atmospheric temperatures from rising by 2 degrees Celsius.

The reduction goal we propose is calculated based on your consumption from the previous year. Remember that individual effort contributes to global benefit. If your habits change but you do not reach your goal, don't get discouraged! Every action counts.

Includes all fixed-income instruments, whether issued by governments, corporations, or state-owned entities, as well as vehicles that invest in them. Depending on the time to maturity, they are classified into short-term (less than a year), medium-term (1 to 3 years), and long-term (more than 3 years).
A category that groups financial assets and positions that, due to their digital nature or the lack of standardized public information, are not considered traditional asset classes.

Includes financial instruments representing direct or indirect ownership of a proportional share of a company's capital. It is characterized by the absence of a guaranteed return or a fixed maturity date.

glomo-flexible-line-credit-faqs-descript: It is the possibility of enrolling in new credit products based on your income and expenses. In this case, your ‘plate’ represents 100% of your credit capacity, and you can add ‘food items’ or increase or decrease ‘portions’; in other words, take out loans or increase or decrease your credit card limits.

You can calculate it by subtracting your fixed monthly expenses (rent, water, electricity) and your variable expenses (your favorite coffee, movie outings, the shoes you liked) from your income. We recommend that your debts do not exceed 30% of your income.
You can add ‘portions’ (increase your credit card limits) or include new ‘food items’ (take out a new personal loan).
Select the card from the product list and slide the control to the right to increase the ‘portion’ (limit) of your credit cards.
Select the card from the product list and slide the control to the left to decrease the ‘portion’ (limit) of your credit cards.
Simply select the ‘New personal loan’ option in the ‘My loans’ list and add a new item to your ‘plate’.
If your ‘plate’ is full because you used all your credit capacity, you can decrease your card limits or pay off your existing loans.

glomo-not-flexible-line-credit-faqs-desc: It is the possibility of taking out new credit products based on your income and expenses. In this case, your 'plate' represents 100% of your credit capacity, and you can add 'foods' or increase or decrease 'portions'; that is, take out loans or increase the limit on your credit cards depending on your payment capacity.

You can calculate it by subtracting your fixed monthly expenses (rent, water, electricity) and your variable expenses (your favorite coffee, movie outings, the shoes you liked) from your income. We recommend that your debts do not exceed 30% of your income.

It is a pre-approved loan that helps you in unexpected situations, emergencies, and opportunities. This loan has fixed biweekly or monthly payments and a fixed interest rate during the term of the loan. Once approved, we deposit it into your account in a single payment.
When you have an available offer, you can access a higher limit on your credit line to buy, pay, or cover an unexpected situation with your BBVA card. The increase has no cost.
If you have a pre-approved offer, you can add 'portions' (increase your credit card limits) or include new 'foods' (take out a new personal loan).
When you have a pre-approved offer to increase your credit line, select the 'New credit line increase' option in the 'My cards' list. It's that simple and fast to increase your card limit.
If you have a pre-approved offer, just select the 'New personal loan' option in the 'My loans' list and add a new one to your 'plate'.
If your 'plate' is full because you have used all your credit capacity, we suggest paying off your existing loans to access more options in the future.
Your credit capacity may currently be fully used. If you have already finished paying one of your loans, your capacity will be updated soon and you may gain access to new offers.

glomo-travel-insurance-coverage-ACME: If the Insured travels accompanied and as the sole person responsible for minors under 16 years of age, and due to a covered accident or serious illness is unable to care for the minors, the Institution will coordinate round-trip transportation for an accredited family member (over 18 years of age).
glomo-travel-insurance-coverage-AMTI: At the Insured’s request and during their trip, medical references, hospitals, and medical service providers within the provider network will be provided. 24 hours a day, 365 days a year.
glomo-travel-insurance-coverage-BEDE: Dental care expenses in case of infection or trauma resulting from a Covered Accident.
glomo-travel-insurance-coverage-BGMA: Medical Expenses for required medical and surgical services and/or materials. The first expense must be incurred within the Travel period and within ten days following the Accident.
glomo-travel-insurance-coverage-BMAV: Death due to an accident occurring while traveling as a passenger on a Public Service Aircraft, or death within 90 calendar days following the accident date.
glomo-travel-insurance-coverage-BPOA: Bodily losses suffered by the insured as a result of a covered accident.
glomo-travel-insurance-coverage-CAVI: In case of cancellation due to serious illness of the Insured and/or direct Family Member, the treating Physician must clinically and in writing recommend the trip cancellation. Non-recovered expenses will be paid by reimbursement.
glomo-travel-insurance-coverage-DAEP: If the insured’s luggage is damaged (one or several suitcases, including personal items, suitcases, briefcases, and garment bags) while in the custody of the Airline Carrier used by the Insured.
glomo-travel-insurance-coverage-DEQP: The Insured will be paid, by reimbursement, the expenses incurred for the reasonable purchase of essential items (basic clothing; comfortable footwear, and personal hygiene items) for use until their checked luggage arrives or up to the insured sum limit. The items and expenses must be reasonable in relation to the luggage delay time.
glomo-travel-insurance-coverage-DEVU: If the delay is longer than twelve hours and is caused by a strike, vehicle hijacking, vehicle failure, Act of God or Force Majeure affecting the maritime, land, or air vehicle, or the Carrier with which the Insured is registered to travel, the Insured will be reimbursed for expenses related to food, lodging, and transportation.
glomo-travel-insurance-coverage-ERDP: If the Insured loses or has their identification documents stolen, assistance will be provided to recover them.
glomo-travel-insurance-coverage-GAFU: Death of the insured at any time.
glomo-travel-insurance-coverage-GAHC: If the Treating Physician prescribes that the insured must remain in convalescence at the place where medical care was provided, lodging will be arranged and coordinated.
glomo-travel-insurance-coverage-INVI: Non-recovered expenses if the Insured is forced to interrupt their trip as a result of illness, accident, or death suffered by the Insured or a Direct Family Member, or due to a serious loss at their home.
glomo-travel-insurance-coverage-LOEQ: Advisory support to the Insured when reporting theft or loss of personal luggage or personal effects, provided they were checked with the Carrier on which the Insured is traveling.
glomo-travel-insurance-coverage-MUAC: Death due to a covered accident and within 90 calendar days following the accident date.
glomo-travel-insurance-coverage-RCIE: Defense expenses incurred by the Insured arising from any lawsuit filed against them, generated by the civil liability incurred. Additionally, amounts that the insured becomes legally obligated to pay will be reimbursed.
glomo-travel-insurance-coverage-REAN: If the Insured or a direct family member suffers an accident or serious illness, death, or a serious loss occurs at the Insured’s declared home.
glomo-travel-insurance-coverage-REQP: If the insured’s luggage is totally stolen or lost while in the custody of an Airline Carrier used by the Passenger, Tour Operator, or Hotel.
glomo-travel-insurance-coverage-RERM: At the request of the deceased insured’s family member, reasonable and necessary services for transporting the remains to the Place of Usual Residence will be coordinated.
glomo-travel-insurance-coverage-RESA: If, at the discretion of the Treating Physician and Medical Team, it is determined that the insured cannot continue their travel itinerary, the repatriation expenses will be arranged and covered according to the most appropriate means of transport based on their medical situation.
glomo-travel-insurance-coverage-SAHO: Support and coordination with providers when the Insured is traveling and their home, inhabited by direct family members, suffers emergencies related to electrical installations, plumbing, locksmithing, and masonry.
glomo-travel-insurance-coverage-SEVC: At the Insured’s request during their trip, telephone Concierge assistance will be provided for: travel recommendations and reservations, entertainment, gifts, shopping, and personal shopping assistance.
glomo-travel-insurance-coverage-TMAS: In case of an accident or serious illness that endangers the life of the insured during their trip, the Institution will coordinate the dispatch of a standard ground ambulance to transfer the Insured to the nearest hospital.
glomo-travel-insurance-coverage-TMUR: Urgent messages arising from an emergency situation will be transmitted by phone to the contact person indicated by the Insured.

metasegura-error-beneficiary-bullet-two-:
If you want to name minors as beneficiaries, you must not appoint an adult as the minors' representative for the purpose of collecting the indemnity on their behalf.

This is because civil laws establish how guardians, executors, heirs' representatives, and similar roles must be appointed, and they do not consider the insurance contract to be the appropriate instrument for those designations.

Appointing an adult as representative of minor beneficiaries, while they are still minors, may legally imply naming that adult as beneficiary, who in any case would only have a moral obligation, since naming beneficiaries in an insurance contract grants the unconditional right to dispose of the insured sum.

payments-mobile-payment-help-question-be: Among many things, we can tell you they are very practical because you can pay for purchases under $400 just by bringing your phone close to the point-of-sale terminal and the charge will be authorized instantly. They are also fast because you can pay contactlessly and without cash; they are safe because your card number is never shared and your information is always protected.
What are the benefits of mobile payments?
payments-mobile-payment-help-question-ca: No. For the payment to be authorized, you must hold your phone at least 4 cm from the point-of-sale terminal, and it is a transaction that is not charged more than once. For even more security, activate the 'Always request unlock' function for all your purchases; this way you will first need to unlock your phone screen and then bring it close to the terminal. To activate this function, go to the 'Settings' section in your BBVA app and in 'Mobile payment' enable the 'Unlock your phone and authorize' option.
Can I be charged twice with this payment method?

It is very difficult. In order to charge you, your phone must be within 4 cm of the terminal with the screen on. Simply having your phone in your bag, standing near, or walking past an enabled terminal will not generate any transaction. However, for more security you can activate the 'Unlock your phone and authorize' option, so the charge will not be authorized unless you first unlock your phone screen and then bring it close to the terminal. To activate this function, go to the 'Settings' section of your BBVA app and in 'Mobile payment' turn it on.
Can accidental or unauthorized charges be made to me?
payments-mobile-payment-help-question-di:
Go to the 'Settings' section of your BBVA app, choose 'Mobile payment', and then select the option to cancel.

Please note that if you cancel, you will no longer be able to make mobile payments in your BBVA app and you will lose the settings you configured.
payments-mobile-payment-help-question-ho: It is a payment method that uses short-range wireless technology (NFC, Near Field Communication) to make secure payments between an enabled phone and a point-of-sale terminal. When you bring your phone close to an enabled point-of-sale terminal, near the 'Contactless payment' symbol, the transaction is authorized.

It is very simple. Pay contactlessly with your phone for all purchases under $400. Look for the 'Contactless payment' symbol near the point-of-sale terminal or ask the seller whether their store accepts this payment method. If it does, just hold your phone at least 4 cm from the terminal and the charge will be made instantly. For more security, you can also activate the option to unlock your phone to authorize these contactless payments.
If your purchase is over $400, you will not be able to make a contactless payment, but you can pay as you always have: by inserting or swiping your card and entering your PIN at the terminal.
How can I pay with my phone?
payments-mobile-payment-help-question-is: It is very safe. When making a mobile payment, your card number and sensitive or personal data are never shared, so your information is always protected.
Is it safe to use my phone to pay?
payments-mobile-payment-help-question-wh: NFC stands for Near Field Communication, a short-range wireless technology that lets you make contactless payments by bringing your phone close to any point-of-sale terminal with contactless technology. You can enable the NFC connection in your phone settings.

You can pay for purchases under $400 in thousands of stores throughout Mexico, and more are joining all the time. Ask the seller whether their store accepts this payment method or look for the 'Contactless payment' symbol near the point-of-sale terminal.
Where can I pay contactlessly with my phone?
